name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Mesin Pencari Doa Ala Google: Dilengkapi Search Bar dan Touch Virtual Keyboard (QWERTY) untuk mencari 227+ doa & dzikir Hisnul Muslim secara cerdas
Pencarian Sinonim & Topik Cepat: Mengetik 'sholat', 'tidur', 'makan', 'sakit', dll langsung menampilkan seluruh doa relevan, didukung 8 chip kategori cepat
Dukungan Dwibahasa Penuh (ID & EN): Judul doa, kategori, tag pencarian, arti doa, dan hadist rujukan otomatis menyesuaikan pengaturan bahasa aplikasi
Unduhan On-Demand & Hemat Memori: Teks doa diunduh sesuai permintaan via GitHub Raw API tanpa membebani ukuran aplikasi (ukuran tetap <= 256 KB)
Tab Tersimpan / Favorit Offline: Doa yang telah dibuka atau dibintangi otomatis tersimpan di memori perangkat dan dapat dibaca kapan saja secara offline
Perbaikan Penuh 6 Gaya Font Jam TrueType & Lockscreen Bebas Crash: Seluruh 6 font jam dan lockscreen berfungsi normal tanpa terpotong
changelog_en: Google-Style Prayer Search Engine: Features a Search Bar with an on-screen QWERTY touch keyboard to smartly search 227+ Hisnul Muslim duas & adhkar
Synonym & Quick Topic Chips: Typing 'prayer', 'sleep', 'food', 'health', etc surfaces all relevant prayers instantly, aided by 8 quick topic chips
Full Bilingual Support (ID & EN): Prayer titles, categories, search tags, meanings, and hadith references adapt seamlessly to app language
On-Demand Download & Slim Binary: Prayer details are fetched on-demand from GitHub Raw API, keeping package size strictly <= 256 KB for OTA
Offline Bookmarks / Saved Tab: Opened and bookmarked prayers are cached locally and accessible anytime offline under the Saved tab
All 6 TrueType Clock Styles & Lockscreen Crash Fix: Fully intact with zero font truncation and smooth lockscreen rendering
